original_test_intent: Read one selected Redfish LogService resource and validate its identity and service metadata without altering logs.
original_method: Resolve a canonical LogService member from the selected Manager's collection, issue one trusted GET to that member, schema-check its identity and capabilities, and store redacted evidence while preserving logs.
manual_activity: Provide the target endpoint, credential handle, CA trust and any project-specific expected LogService properties; no interactive test action is required.
required_inputs: Project expected service properties when applicable
safety_requirements: Resolve service from collection rather than free-form text
Never clear, delete or truncate logs
Never invoke ClearLog or Entries mutation
agent_execution_scope: Bind BMC, Manager and firmware identity
Fetch or consume validated LogServices membership
Capture HTTP metadata and restricted raw hash
Validate @odata identity, schema, name, entries link and advertised actions

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: A member GET is correct only when `$LOGS` is resolved from the collection; the source's log clearing, `-k`, hardcoded credentials and readability-only check must not be used.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Select one canonical member from LogServices, use trusted TLS and secret-provider credentials for one bounded GET, validate identity/schema/capabilities and preserve all logs.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Manager/LogService resource GET and 15/10 timing remain; no service instance or expected vendor field is invented.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Traverse from Manager to LogServices to the selected member and validate the returned resource against the same canonical URI.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds collection-derived identity, link containment, schema/capability checks, trusted access and evidence preservation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Covers service metadata only; entry content and log lifecycle actions remain separate cases.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A valid resource cannot prove logging delivery, retention, rollover or entry correctness without separate stimuli and entry inspection.

project_override_considerations: Vendor-specific properties and actions may be recorded, but the agent must not invoke them. Project expectations are data inputs, not inferred from the service name.
expected_evidence: Parent collection identity and selected canonical member URI
HTTP status/content type/timing and restricted raw hash
Entries link and advertised action inventory without invocation
Proof no clear, delete, truncation or unrelated mutation occurred

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The title, URI and GET agree on an individual LogService read. The unsafe setup and unresolved placeholder are execution defects, not conflicting source identities.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The parent collection, endpoint, trust and normal validation inputs are discoverable prerequisites for a fully automatable read.

review_improvement: Replaces a free-form instance dump with a canonical collection-derived resource validation and removes destructive log clearing.
independent_technical_reasoning: A LogService identifier must be treated as an object selected from the parent collection, not as untrusted path text. Otherwise the request may target a nonexistent service, another Manager or an action-like route. The response must echo the canonical resource identity and expose internally valid service metadata and links. None of those checks require physical intervention, so the row remains fully automatable, while the action inventory is evidence only and must never be executed by this read case.
